'''Sy Bisti''' was a [[Trade language/Legends|trade language]] used in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and in parts of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Though not as common as [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]], it frequently served as a common language between the denizens of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] bordering [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and the Unknown Regions, and [[Species/Legends|species]] from those regions whom had not learned [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] knew this [[Language/Legends|language]] prior to their first contact with citizens of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="OBF" /> Individuals living on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] often knew Sy Bisti,<ref name="RECG" /> and it was frequently a second language among the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] and [[Vagaari/Legends|Vaagari]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sy Bisti made its first appearance in the novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="OBF" /> It was later referenced in the ''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]'', where its name was misspelled as "Sy Bysti".<ref name="RECG" />
